learning_objective: 🎯 We will explore the world of straight and curved lines and draw amazing shapes!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A straight line looks like a tight string. It does not bend at all! The edge of your book or a ruler is a perfectly straight line.
A curved line is bouncy and bendy like a smile or a wavy road. A circle is made of a beautiful curved line that goes all the way around.
When we connect two dots, we make a line! We can use many straight and curved lines to draw houses, trees, and animals.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Thread Art
fun_activity.instructions: Take a piece of thread. Hold it tight to show a STRAIGHT line. Then put it nicely on a table to make a wavy CURVED line!

quick_recap: ⭐ There are two main types of lines: straight and curved.
⭐ Every object around us has lines in it.
⭐ We can draw beautiful pictures just by mixing different lines.
